basic_info.description: Welcome to Park 324, a rare gem in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Mission Bay neighborhood! Nestled within One Mission Bay, one of the city's most sought-after addresses, this spacious 1BD/1BA home features a unique private patio overlooking a serene courtyard. With only nine homes like this in the entire building, this is a truly special opportunity.Step inside to an inviting open floor plan, where hardwood floors seamlessly guide you from the gracious entryway to the impeccably designed kitchen. Outfitted with sleek Domus & Domus cabinetry and premium Gaggenau appliancesincluding a five-burner gas cooktop, wall oven, and paneled refrigerator and dishwasherthis kitchen is as functional as it is stylish.  One Mission Bay is an architectural standout, perfectly positioned along the water with stunning views of Mission Creek. Enjoy unparalleled access to Oracle Park, the Chase Center, and the best of Mission Bay's dynamic lifestyle.
